info.description: Auto-generated. Base URL http://localhost:9010/api (PORT from backend .env + /api global prefix). If EVERY request 404s: (1) backend not running (npm run start in Accurate_Node), (2) wrong port in baseUrl, (3) missing /api prefix. Auth: Bearer JWT (userToken/adminToken/managerToken) or cookies. Copy token from Login into variables. Placeholder id 507f1f77bcf86cd799439011 does NOT exist in DB -> Get-by-ID returns 404 until you substitute a real _id (or {{productId}}/{{userId}}). File uploads use form-data (select file in Postman where src is empty).
